rule: Holdout-v3 labels (ingredients/holdout-v3.jsonl, split holdout3) were written blind from CONTRACT-v1 §7 and §12 by the evaluation worker (no parser was run on these inputs), checked by an independent label checker who saw no engine output, and adjudicated with the rationale logged in LABEL-CHANGES.md before this freeze (EVALUATION-PLAN-v3). They are never tuned against engine output and never shown to the implementation worker. Any change needs an entry in LABEL-CHANGES.md (case id, old and new label, an independent rationale that does not cite engine output, and a reviewer) and a new FREEZE-v3.json with the previous hash recorded in that entry; a change made after a candidate has been scored on holdout-v3 makes its holdout-v3 results exposed, not fresh (EVALUATION-PLAN-v3).
canonicalization: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of ingredients/holdout-v3.jsonl; counts from its non-empty lines.
